regime_context: Detector shows a narrow, one-narrative China A-shares tape: Coal is the lone eligible leader (rank 1, score 0.992) in a mean-reverting regime, with Gold Miners as an ineligible challenger and Banks the only other eligible name (crowded, rank 3). The backtest verdict is explicit that the absolute-trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown on this market's history (gate_helps=false), cross-sectional rank-IC ~0, and rotation timing is display-only — so any lean here is experimental judgement, not validated edge. Track record shows directional accuracy of 0.337 (below coin-flip) on n=98, which mandates low conviction across the board.
emerging_watch: Watching Banks (512800.SS): it is the only other eligible theme and shows the strongest trend-health profile (durability_bar 0.83, hurst_tag trend, breadth 1.0) but is flagged crowded (z=1.83). Observation: if Banks' momentum score sustains above Coal's while Coal's crowding_z crosses above 1.0, that would mark a CONFIRMED leadership handoff toward a more durable trend — retire this watch if Coal's score gap over Banks widens back above 0.15.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only eligible leader with a positive momentum score (0.992) AND a one-narrative flag with breadth 0.5, indicating leadership concentration rather than broad participation. The trend-gate says it is eligible (unlike Gold Miners at rank 2 which is ineligible), so within this detector's language it is the only theme that has passed the absolute-trend check. However, hurst_tag is mean-revert and gate_helps is false on this market, so this is a size-down candidate at most — a directional lean driven by concentration, not durability. Crowding is absent (crowded=false, crowding_z 0.59), so no sizing caution beyond the experimental nature of the whole framework on this tape.
theses.dissent: Coal's hurst_tag is mean-revert and durability_bar is only 0.52, meaning leadership has not persisted long enough to signal trend health; the market's mean-reverting character (gate_helps=false) is exactly the regime where a rank-1 momentum name whipsaws hardest, and a 0.34 absorption with directional=false suggests the narrative is neither broad nor confirmed — the lead could vanish without any rotation handoff.

falsifier.text: Coal's proxy 515220.SS underperforms the CSI 300 by more than 5% within the 20-day horizon while still holding rank 1 in the detector
